description: List the customers (with their names) and event types your workspace's usage signals use, with how many signals each has, most first, at most 200 of each: the values list_usage_signals takes as customer_id and event_type. Each list is narrowed by the time, agent and the other list's filter, never by its own. Answers 404 (not released) until signal filters are switched on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

end_date.description: Only signals up to this time, ISO 8601.

event_type.description: Only these event types (at most 50; a type containing a comma cannot be named).

start_date.description: Only signals from this time on, ISO 8601.

name: list_usage_signal_filters
